scope: Bounded source-context inspection and author editorial consistency review for two existing Japanese practical mock stems. Exact technical definition verification against cited PDF is NOT claimed.

sourceVisualReview.method: Rendered actual exact-hash PDF pages89/90/91/106/127/128/139/141 at1.3x and visually inspected all8fullpage images; text extraction only cross-check.

findings.observedPdfSupport: Physical106 table7-7 lists thermistor among other passive components. Physical127 defines resistance;128is capacitor context;139diode and141ICcontext do not directly teach the exact thermistor temperature-sensing proposition.
findings.canonicalBasis: Lesson066 section-1 already distinguishes resistor temperature coefficients and section-3/termサーミスタ teaches temperature-related resistance changes; all four existing question rationales already distinguish sensing purpose from fixed-resistor use.
findings.editorialDecision: Specify temperature detection as primary purpose in this question. Does not claim every thermistor application is temperature detection, or fixed resistors have no temperature coefficient.

findings.observedPdfSupport: Physical89–90 covers soldering tools/materials/flux/procedure;91is an exercise panel excluded from authorship. These cited pages do not explicitly define solder bridge or land.
findings.canonicalBasis: Lesson065 section-3 already identifies bridge as defect and requires approved rework/reinspection. Existing correct rationale defines bridge as an unwanted connection to an adjacent part; other rationales distinguish it from normal tolerance and flux.
findings.editorialDecision: Explicitly state adjacent land should not be connected. Does not imply all adjacent pads must always be isolated or authorize any rework procedure.
